client.stdin: 80-byte request header; OPEN is followed by exactly payload_len opaque JSON bytes
client.stdout: 16-byte output header plus exact payload_len bytes
client.lifetime: one live connection; caller death, stdin EOF or STOP revokes execution

envelope.authority: fixed trusted authority request interpreted only by fresh private-UID Node

fds.6: 32-byte reply header plus stdout then stderr

native_proof_hash: SHA-256 of the exact native terminal JSON body before adding proof_sha256; native journal stores this digest, then the original cleanup endpoint is rechecked before publication
positive_terminal: status=completed, all physical/drain/readback/journal booleans true, commands>=1, authority_status=0, observed_ns<cleanup_deadline_ns; opaque A result alone is never acceptance
